in_sanskrit.name: Kale
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Black, Dark
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Kale एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Derived from the Sanskrit word 'kala', meaning 'time', 'darkness', or 'black'. In Hindu mythology, Kali is a goddess of time, destruction, and creation. She is also known as the 'Mother of the Universe'.

in_hindi.name: काले
in_hindi.long_meaning: This name is derived from the Sanskrit word 'kala' which means 'time'. Over time, the meaning of the name shifted to 'black' or 'dark' due to the association of time with darkness.

in_tamil.long_meaning: The Tamil word 'kale' is derived from the Sanskrit word 'kala', which means 'time'. The name can be interpreted as 'the moment' or 'the age'.
